requests.prompt: Create one method-validation sample from this exact source photograph. The source vehicle is an ordinary pre-facelift Lada Granta liftback, five doors including the sloped rear hatch, not a sedan and not Sport/Cross. Preserve its exact recognizable old-style rectangular headlamps, two-bar black grille with Lada emblem, hood, body side crease, fuel door, door handles, mirrors, wheel-cover style, rear side quarter window, roof and rear hatch proportions. Keep the source camera viewpoint and whole vehicle facing toward the right in the same front three-quarter view; do not mirror or impose another vehicle camera angle. Make a clean photorealistic catalog representation of the same white car: remove street dirt, rust, background, snow, fence, other vehicles, reflected scenery, and license plate text. Restore clean factory white paint without redesigning trim. Show the complete car with both visible wheels, tires, roof antenna and mirrors intact, with comfortable transparent margin on every side. Actual transparent RGBA background, natural realistic glass and interior retained, no opaque window cutouts. No floor, ground shadow, reflection, text, border, labels, watermark or checkerboard. This is a proposed source-preserving method sample; do not invent Sport trim, body kits, roof accessories or an exact model year.
requests.input_role: exact vehicle identity and source camera view; no cross-vehicle reference
requests.tool_model: not exposed by tool; not inferred

visual_review.observations: 实际灰底查看：车体、车窗与两轮可见，天线在顶部被画布切断。PNG顶部22个非透明像素；未满足完整附件与留白，退回。

requests.prompt: Image 1 is the real identity photograph of the exact ordinary white pre-facelift Lada Granta five-door liftback. Image 2 is an incomplete first catalog sample of this same car, provided only as an editing target. Make a new complete transparent catalog sample of this exact car, keeping its old rectangular headlamps, black two-bar grille and Lada emblem, five-door liftback roof/hatch, four side doors, rain guards, black mirrors and handles, white paint, wheel covers, side creases and right-facing front three-quarter source view. Correct the framing decisively: make the entire car substantially smaller within a roomy landscape canvas, about 80 percent of image width; all bodywork, both wheels, mirrors and the ENTIRE roof antenna including its thin tip must have broad transparent breathing room, at least 8 percent canvas clearance above the antenna and below the tire bottoms. The antenna must be a complete continuous stock antenna, not cropped, doubled or extended out of the frame. Remove any floating fragments, colored specks and pale background fringe outside the silhouette. Keep realistic interior and glass; no transparent holes through windscreen. Clean factory-condition paint; no dirt, rust or unrelated background reflections. Actual RGBA transparency. No road, snow, floor, shadow, reflection, text, watermark or checkerboard. Do not invent Sport/Cross trim, change body type, mirror the vehicle or impose a pickup-style camera. This is a proposed method-validation sample, not a declared final design standard.
requests.input_role: exact vehicle identity and source camera view; no cross-vehicle reference
requests.previous_failure: antenna touches top canvas boundary; insufficient margins
requests.tool_model: not exposed by tool; not inferred

visual_review.observations: 分别在灰底与深灰底实际查看：完整天线尖端、车顶、两轮、镜壳与整车均在画布内；四扇侧门、斜背尾部、后侧三角窗、老式矩形灯组与Granta普通版格栅特征保持。白车清洁，无地面、阴影、重复车体或明显背景残留，玻璃中内饰保留。工具透明预览的浅色零点须与实际合成区分；alpha>=16的可见区域bbox为[214,84,1545,844]，灰/深底未见明显游离碎点。未宣称像素锁定、精确车型年或已取得俄罗斯视觉样例批准。
visual_review.technical_note: alpha>0 bbox[0,39,1548,857]含极低alpha；可见主体边界留白约214/84/229/43px。不以该样张参数替代未确认俄罗斯最终规格。
